name: session-radar
description: Claude Code desktop (macOS) mod: per-session completion notifications that jump to the session on click, a custom sound, a 'recent sessions' pane with background-subagent status, and token usage / cost stats.

doneSound.title: Done sound / 完成提示音
doneSound.description: Sound played when a turn finishes. A name from ~/Library/Sounds or /System/Library/Sounds (e.g. Glass, Hero, Ping, Submarine), or an absolute path to an audio file.

errorSound.title: Error sound / 出错提示音
errorSound.description: Sound played when a turn errors or is interrupted. Same format as doneSound.

sound.title: Play sound / 播放提示音
sound.description: Play a sound when a turn finishes.

notify.title: macOS notification / 系统通知
notify.description: Show a macOS notification when a turn finishes (clickable if terminal-notifier is installed).

notifyMinSeconds.title: Min seconds to notify / 最短提醒时长
notifyMinSeconds.description: Turns that finish faster than this (seconds) do not notify or play a sound. Errors always do.

speak.title: Speak / 语音播报
speak.description: Also speak '<session> done' with the macOS voice.

keepDays.title: Keep days / 记录保留天数
keepDays.description: How many days of sessions the pane keeps.
